summary: Iteration 179: LUMI Icon, Microsoft SSO Placeholder & Knowledge Graph Interactivity - ALL TESTS PASSED. Backend: 2/2 MS SSO endpoints working (GET /microsoft/config returns configured:false, POST /microsoft/login returns 501 with proper message). Frontend: LUMI icon visible in login hero, mobile header, sidebar, welcome screen, and portal selector. Knowledge Graph nodes are interactive with hover highlighting, click to show detail card, and click-elsewhere to deselect.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 179 verified 3 new features: 1) LUMI icon PNG at /lumi-icon.png integrated in LumiLogin hero, mobile header, sidebar, welcome screen, and PortalSelector. 2) Microsoft SSO placeholder returns 501 with clear 'not configured' message when AZURE_* keys missing. 3) Knowledge Graph KnowledgeTab has interactive nodes (data-testid='kg-node-{i}') with hover highlighting, detail card popup (data-testid='kg-detail-card'), and click-to-dismiss. All previous features remain working.
